script.spoken: CHAIN LOCKERS FLOOD, RIG CAPSIZES. The crew abandoned it, and all eighty four men died. It started with one broken porthole. Seawater flooded the ballast control panel. The panel shorted, and valves began acting on their own. The rig tilted forward, and water entered its chain lockers. It rolled over before dawn. Rig ballast systems, training and survival gear were improved.
